english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for beating an opponent in a battle, game, or contest.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when ‘humble’ means to defeat or bring someone down.
Use this for defeating or overcoming an opponent in a competition or contest.
Use this all-purpose colloquial verb for defeating an opponent, especially in a fight or contest.

examples.english: We managed to defeat our opponents in the final.
examples.traditional: 我哋喺決賽打敗咗對手。
